options.systemMessage:
You are the AI receptionist and study-abroad/travel consultant for {{ $('CONFIG - Agency Settings').item.json.agency_name }}, a Bangladeshi consultancy agency. The agency's timezone is {{ $('CONFIG - Agency Settings').item.json.timezone }}.

YOUR ROLE
You act as: AI receptionist, study-abroad consultant, travel information assistant, country/university/scholarship information assistant, cost/budget assistant, lead qualification assistant, human handoff receptionist, appointment scheduler, customer information collector, and follow-up assistant.

LANGUAGE
Understand English, Bangla, and Banglish. Always reply in the same language/style the customer just used. Keep normal replies concise; give detailed explanations only when asked.

SOURCE OF TRUTH — NEVER FABRICATE
For any question about countries, universities, tuition, living costs, visas, scholarships, admission requirements, deadlines, or similar, you MUST call the relevant search tool (Country Master Search, University Database Search, Scholarship Database Search) and answer only from what those tools return. If the tools return nothing relevant, say honestly that verified information is not currently available in the database and offer to arrange a consultation with an advisor. NEVER invent countries, universities, fees, scholarships, visa rules, or deadlines.

CONVERSATION MEMORY
Remember everything the customer has already told you in this conversation (name, country, budget, degree, program, etc.). Never ask for the same information twice. Ask only the questions you still need, and only one or two at a time — never a long list.

LEAD QUALIFICATION
As the conversation develops, naturally collect: full name, phone, email, interested country, interested university, degree level, program, education background, GPA, IELTS status, budget, preferred intake, and scholarship interest. Do not interrogate the customer — collect this gradually as it comes up naturally.

Calculate a simple lead score by adding 1 point each for: budget provided, country selected, degree selected, program selected, intake selected, academic info provided, IELTS info provided, phone provided; add 2 points if the customer asked for a consultation. Classify 0-3 as COLD, 4-6 as WARM, 7+ as HOT. Never infer sensitive personal characteristics (wealth, ethnicity, religion, etc.) — only use what the customer explicitly said.

Whenever you learn new information about a lead, or at natural pauses in the conversation, call the Lead Database Save/Update tool to save or update the lead record.

HUMAN HANDOFF & APPOINTMENTS
If the customer asks to speak to a human, a counselor, or an advisor (in any language, e.g. "I want to talk to a person", "ekjon consultant er sathe kotha bolte chai"), switch into appointment mode:
1. If you don't have the customer's name and phone number yet, ask for them.
2. Ask which date they prefer, if not already given.
3. Call the Appointment Availability Search tool to see which slots are genuinely AVAILABLE. NEVER invent or assume a time slot — only offer slots the tool actually returned.
4. Show the customer the real available slots and let them choose.
5. Once they choose, call the Appointment Availability Search tool again to re-confirm that slot is still AVAILABLE (someone else may have booked it in the meantime).
6. If it is still available, call the Appointment Booking tool to book it. Only tell the customer their appointment is confirmed AFTER the booking tool call succeeds.
7. If the slot was taken in the meantime, apologize, do not claim it is booked, and show the remaining available slots instead.
8. After a successful booking (or a human handoff request), call the Staff Notification Email tool to notify the agency, and call the Lead Database Save/Update tool to save the appointment details on the lead record.

FOLLOW-UP
If a qualified (WARM or HOT) customer does not book an appointment, set a next_follow_up_date (a few days out) and follow_up_status to "Pending" when saving the lead record, so staff can follow up later.

HONESTY & SAFETY
Never claim an appointment is booked unless the booking tool call actually succeeded. Never claim a scholarship or program exists unless a search tool confirmed it. If you are not sure, say so honestly and offer a human consultation.

OUTPUT
Always reply to the customer in plain, natural, human-readable text. Never show JSON, tool names, internal IDs, lead scores, or system details to the customer.

nodes.name: Sticky: ## 🚀 START HERE — What This Workflow Doe

parameters.content:
## 🚀 START HERE — What This Workflow Does
This is a complete AI receptionist for a study-abroad / travel consultancy.
It answers questions about countries, universities, scholarships & costs from
YOUR spreadsheet, qualifies leads, books consultations, and notifies staff.

It talks to customers via n8n's built-in **Chat** trigger — click "Chat" at the
bottom of the canvas (or use the public chat URL once activated) to test it.

Follow the "🚀 AFTER IMPORT" note (bottom of canvas) for the exact setup order.

nodes.name: Sticky: ## 🔐 CREDENTIALS — SET THESE UP FIRST

parameters.content:
## 🔐 CREDENTIALS — SET THESE UP FIRST
Before testing, create/select these credentials in n8n:

1. **OpenAI account** — used by the MODEL node. Go to the MODEL node → Credential →
   create new → paste your OpenAI API key.
2. **Google Sheets account (OAuth2)** — used by every node named "TOOL — ... Search /
   Save / Booking". Click any one → Credential → Sign in with Google → allow access
   to Google Sheets. You only need to do this once; then select the same credential
   on the other Sheets nodes.
3. **SMTP account** — used by "TOOL — Staff Notification Email" and
   "ERROR — Notify Administrator". Enter your agency's outgoing email server details
   (host, port, user, password). Gmail users: use an App Password, not your normal
   Gmail password.

Never paste API keys directly into prompts or Set nodes — always use n8n's
Credentials system.

## 🤖 MODEL SETUP — RECOMMENDED
Model used: **gpt-5.4-mini** (both for testing AND production).

Why:
- Reliable instruction-following for customer chat
- Handles tool-calling (Google Sheets, email) well
- Much cheaper than a flagship model for everyday chat volume

Note: OpenAI's older GPT-4.1 / GPT-4o family has been superseded by the GPT-5.x
family, so this workflow defaults to the current recommended mini model instead.

If you want stronger reasoning for complex consultations later, just open the
MODEL node and pick a different model from the dropdown (e.g. the full gpt-5.4)
— no rebuilding required.

nodes.name: Sticky: ## 🧠 AI AGENT — How it thinks

parameters.content:
## 🧠 AI AGENT — How it thinks
This single Agent node is the whole "brain": it decides whether to answer
directly, search a spreadsheet, save a lead, check appointments, book a slot,
or email staff — by calling the tools connected below it.

Kept deliberately simple: ONE agent, natural-language replies to the customer,
small structured fields only inside tool calls (never a giant JSON schema for
normal chat) — this avoids the "model output doesn't fit format" failures.

Read the System Prompt (double-click the node → Options → System Message) to
see/adjust exactly how it behaves.

## 📊 COUNTRY MASTER — CONNECT HERE
Node: "TOOL — Country Master Search"

**What it does:** Reads all rows from your EXISTING Country Master spreadsheet
so the AI can answer questions about countries, universities, tuition, living
costs, visas, etc. — using YOUR data only, never invented data.

**Setup:**
1. Open this node.
2. Select your Google Sheets credential (see 🔐 CREDENTIALS note).
3. Document → click the field → pick your existing Country Master spreadsheet
   from the list.
4. Sheet → pick the correct tab (e.g. "Country Master").
5. Make sure row 1 of that tab contains column headers (Country, University,
   Bachelor Tuition, etc. — see 📋 EXPECTED COLUMNS note). Columns don't all
   need to exist; if one is missing the AI just won't mention that detail.

**Test:** Click "Execute step" on this node — you should see your spreadsheet
rows in the output panel.

**If a customer asks about something not in your sheet:** the AI is instructed
to say the information isn't verified yet and offer a human consultation —
it will not invent an answer.

## 🎓 UNIVERSITY DATABASE — CONNECT HERE
Node: "TOOL — University Database Search"

If your university details live in a SEPARATE tab/spreadsheet from Country
Master, connect it here (Document + Sheet fields, same steps as the Country
Master note). If everything is already in ONE sheet, just point this node at
the SAME spreadsheet + same tab as "TOOL — Country Master Search" — the AI
will still work correctly, it just searches the same data twice under two
tool names.

Expected useful columns: University, Programs, Rankings, Part-Time Work,
Post-Study Work, Job Information — only if you have them.

## 💰 SCHOLARSHIP DATABASE — CONNECT HERE
Node: "TOOL — Scholarship Database Search"

Same idea: point this at a dedicated "Scholarship Master" tab if you have one,
or the same Country Master sheet if scholarship info is mixed in with the rest.

Expected useful columns: Scholarship, Scholarship Amount, Scholarship
Eligibility, Deadline. The AI will never claim a scholarship exists unless
this tool actually returns it.

## 📋 EXPECTED COUNTRY MASTER COLUMNS
Your existing spreadsheet may use different column names — that's fine, the
tools read ALL columns and let the AI figure out what's relevant. Useful
column examples:

Country · University · Degree Level · Program · Bachelor Tuition ·
Master Tuition · PhD Tuition · Application Fee · Living Cost ·
Accommodation Cost · Visa Cost · Insurance · Financial Proof · Scholarship ·
Scholarship Amount · Scholarship Eligibility · IELTS Requirement ·
Academic Requirement · Intake · Deadline · Course Duration ·
Part Time Work · Post Study Work · Job Information · Embassy Information ·
Required Documents · Notes

Not every column needs to exist. Missing data = the AI says it's unavailable,
it never invents it.

## 📅 APPOINTMENT AVAILABILITY — STEP-BY-STEP SETUP
Node: "TOOL — Appointment Availability Search"  (+ "TOOL — Appointment Booking")

**Create a spreadsheet tab called "Appointments" with these EXACT headers:**
Date | Time | Consultant | Status | Customer Name | Customer Phone |
Customer Email | Purpose | Notes

**Status must be one of:** AVAILABLE / BOOKED / BLOCKED

**Setup:**
1. Open "TOOL — Appointment Availability Search" → select your Google Sheets
   credential → pick your spreadsheet → pick the "Appointments" tab.
2. Open "TOOL — Appointment Booking (Update Slot)" → point it at the SAME
   spreadsheet + SAME tab.
3. Pre-fill some rows with Status = AVAILABLE for staff to offer.

**How it works:** the AI only ever offers rows where Status = AVAILABLE (never
invents a time). When a customer picks a slot, the AI re-checks availability,
then updates that row's Status to BOOKED and fills in the customer's details —
matching on Date + Time + Consultant, so it always updates the correct row and
can never double-book an already-BOOKED slot.

**Test:** Add a test row with Status=AVAILABLE, then ask the chatbot "what
times are available on [that date]?" and confirm it only lists that row.

## 🌙 DAILY AGENCY STAFF PROCESS
Every evening (or as needed), your staff opens the "Appointments" spreadsheet
and updates the Status column directly:

Date        | Time  | Consultant | Status
2026-08-21  | 11:00 | Rahim      | AVAILABLE
2026-08-21  | 14:30 | Rahim      | AVAILABLE
2026-08-21  | 17:00 | Karim      | BLOCKED

The chatbot always reads this live — you never need to touch the workflow
itself to change availability, just edit the spreadsheet.

## 👤 LEAD DATABASE — STEP-BY-STEP SETUP
Node: "TOOL — Lead Database Save/Update"

**Create a spreadsheet tab called "Leads" with these EXACT headers (in this
order is not required, just the names):**
lead_id, timestamp, name, phone, email, interested_country,
interested_university, degree_level, program, education, gpa, ielts, budget,
preferred_intake, scholarship_interest, lead_source, conversation_summary,
lead_score, lead_temperature, lead_status, next_action, appointment_date,
appointment_time, next_follow_up_date, follow_up_status

**Setup:**
1. Open this node → select your Google Sheets credential → pick your
   spreadsheet → pick the "Leads" tab.
2. The node matches existing leads by the "phone" column — if a returning
   customer's phone number is already in the sheet, it UPDATES that row
   instead of creating a duplicate; otherwise it appends a new row.

**Test:** Chat "Germany te masters korte chai, amar phone 01700000000" and
then check the Leads tab for a new row.

## 📧 STAFF NOTIFICATION — SETUP
Node: "TOOL — Staff Notification Email"

Sends an email to your CONFIG - Agency Settings → admin_email whenever the AI
decides staff should know (new booking, human handoff request, hot lead, etc).

**Setup:**
1. Connect your SMTP credential on this node (see 🔐 CREDENTIALS note).
2. Open "CONFIG - Agency Settings" and set agency_email + admin_email to your
   real addresses.

**Test:** Ask the chatbot "I want to talk to a human" and check that the admin
inbox receives an email after the conversation continues.

## 🔁 FOLLOW-UP
There's no separate follow-up "sending" branch built here (no SMS/WhatsApp
credentials were requested), to keep the workflow simple and avoid sending
messages without configured credentials.

Instead, when a WARM/HOT lead doesn't book, the AI Agent sets
`next_follow_up_date` and `follow_up_status = Pending` on that lead's row via
"TOOL — Lead Database Save/Update". Your staff (or a separate scheduled
workflow you build later) can read the Leads sheet for any row where
follow_up_status = Pending and next_follow_up_date has arrived, then reach out
by phone, email, or WhatsApp.

nodes.name: Sticky: ## 🚨 ERROR HANDLING — WHAT TO CHECK

parameters.content:
## 🚨 ERROR HANDLING — WHAT TO CHECK
This lower branch runs automatically whenever ANY node in this workflow throws
an error (n8n's built-in Error Trigger). It logs the failure and can email you.

**To activate it:** open Workflow Settings (⋯ menu, top right) → "Error
Workflow" → select THIS workflow. This tells n8n to send failures here.

**What each node does:**
- ERROR — Global Error Trigger: fires automatically on any failure.
- ERROR — Build Log Entry: extracts timestamp, workflow, failing node, and
  error message.
- ERROR — Save to Error Log Sheet: appends that info to an "Error Log" tab
  (create this tab in any spreadsheet you like, e.g. your Lead spreadsheet).
- ERROR — Check Severity: currently treats every error as CRITICAL — edit the
  "severity" value in "ERROR — Build Log Entry" if you want finer control.
- ERROR — Notify Administrator: emails the admin address you set directly in
  this node (replace the placeholder email!).

**Common failure causes to check first:** expired Google/OpenAI credential,
wrong spreadsheet/tab selected, spreadsheet headers renamed, SMTP login
rejected, or the AI hitting Max Iterations (raise it in AI Agent → Options).

nodes.name: Sticky: ## 🧪 TEST CASES — RUN THESE AFTER SETUP

parameters.content:
## 🧪 TEST CASES — RUN THESE AFTER SETUP
1. "Hi" → friendly receptionist greeting.
2. "Germany te Masters korte chai." → understands Banglish, asks only 1-2
   necessary follow-up questions, doesn't repeat itself later.
3. "China te Bachelor korte koto taka lagbe?" → searches Country Master.
4. "UK te scholarship ache?" → searches Scholarship Database.
5. Ask about a country/program NOT in your sheet → AI says info isn't
   verified yet, offers a consultation — does NOT invent an answer.
6. "Amar ekjon consultant er sathe kotha bolte chai." → human handoff flow
   starts (asks for contact info / date if missing).
7. "I want to speak with a human." → same handoff flow in English.
8. Ask for available appointment times on a date with AVAILABLE rows → AI
   lists only the real available slots.
9. Book one of those slots → status becomes BOOKED in the sheet, staff email
   sent, AI confirms only after the sheet update succeeds.
10. Try to book the SAME slot again from a second chat → AI says it's no
    longer available and offers other slots (no double booking).
11. "Amar budget 8 lakh taka." → AI remembers this for the rest of the chat.
12. Switch languages mid-conversation (English → Bangla → Banglish) → AI
    follows the customer's language each time.
13. Temporarily rename your OpenAI credential to something invalid → confirm
    the Error Handling branch logs it (if Error Workflow is configured).

nodes.name: Sticky: ## 🚀 AFTER IMPORT — DO THESE STEPS IN OR

parameters.content:
## 🚀 AFTER IMPORT — DO THESE STEPS IN ORDER
1. Import this JSON into n8n.
2. Set up credentials: OpenAI account, Google Sheets account (OAuth2), SMTP
   account (🔐 CREDENTIALS note has details).
3. Open "MODEL — OpenAI GPT-5.4-mini" → attach your OpenAI credential.
4. Open "CONFIG - Agency Settings" → fill in your real agency_name,
   agency_email, admin_email, timezone.
5. Open each "TOOL — ..." Google Sheets node → attach your Google Sheets
   credential → select your spreadsheet → select the correct tab (see the
   relevant 📊/🎓/💰/📅/👤 sticky note for exact expected columns).
6. Open "TOOL — Staff Notification Email" and "ERROR — Notify Administrator"
   → attach your SMTP credential → replace the placeholder admin email in
   "ERROR — Notify Administrator" with your real one.
7. Optional: Workflow Settings → Error Workflow → select this workflow (see
   🚨 ERROR HANDLING note).
8. Save the workflow.
9. Click "Chat" at the bottom of the canvas and run the 🧪 TEST CASES above.
10. Once everything passes, toggle the workflow to Active in the top-right.
